## Outcome

What problem does this solve, and what observable behavior changes?
Link the spec/issue and execution plan when relevant.

## Risk and scope

LOW / NORMAL / HIGH, with the reason. Note material contract changes or deviations.

## Evidence

Commands/checks actually run and results. Include a failing-then-passing regression
result for bugs when available. State what remains unverified.

## Review and continuity

Record relevant self-review or independent review and docs/plan updates.
HIGH: identify the human plan check and fresh independent review before merge.
